text: Prosus N.V., a global consumer internet group listed on Euronext Amsterdam, acquired a majority stake in GoodHabitz B.V., the European online-training provider that is PSV's back-of-shirt sponsor, for approximately 212 million euros (announced 15 June 2021).
short: Prosus acquired a majority stake in GoodHabitz for ~EUR 212m in 2021.

source.name: GoodHabitz company news: Prosus to acquire majority stake in GoodHabitz
source.quote: Prosus N.V. ("Prosus"), a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world, announced today that it has acquired a majority stake in GoodHabitz B.V. (“GoodHabitz”), a European provider of online training for businesses, for approximately €212 million.

additionalSources.name: Silicon Canals: Naspers spin-off Prosus acquires majority stake in Dutch edtech company GoodHabitz for EUR 212M
additionalSources.quote: Prosus — the international assets holding arm of South African multinational Naspers, has announced today that it has acquired a majority stake in GoodHabitz – a provider of online training for businesses.
